subject: Purchase reference gap — ledger entry clarification and spend ceiling amendment
body:
Message 1
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@starlite-ware.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: PO number and spend ceiling for Starlite order

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. I'm attaching our onboarding form and the initial line item export from our billing system. Procurement needs a formal purchase reference / PO number to move this into our AP queue — currently our invoices reference internal number PR-98765 which I understand doesn't match Redwood's purchase-ref convention.

A few quick asks so we can get committed:
- Can you confirm the exact purchase reference format Redwood will accept?
- We have a target spend ceiling of $75,000 for the first 90 days; is that acceptable as a provisional cap while we complete the vendor setup?
- One of our invoice rows is bundled (SKU ST-WR-LOUD) but needs to be split into two billable line items on your side (compute + support). I attached starlite_lineitems_v1.csv showing the bundle.

Attached: starlite_onboard_form.pdf, starlite_lineitems_v1.csv

Best,
Alicia Moreno
Procurement Lead
Starlite Ware
---

Message 2
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@starlite-ware.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 10:35:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number and spend ceiling for Starlite order

Hi Alicia — thanks for the files. Quick notes:

1) Purchase reference: our procurement system expects a purchase reference of the form PR-YYYY-<vendor short>-<seq>. For provisional / manual allocations we can issue a temporary PR-2026-SL-11 while the account is fully onboarded. That should satisfy AP to start payment processing.

2) Ledger mismatch: your invoice referencing PR-98765 won't map automatically. If you can populate the purchase_ref field in your CSV (or confirm which of your rows map to our line codes) procurement can do a one-time backfill. To keep things clean, please mark which rows are recurring vs one-time.

3) Spend ceiling: $75,000 provisional is fine from a sales perspective, but finance/procurement will need to approve it formally. Looping Laura on this email to request the provisional cap and to confirm any PO issuance constraints.

4) Line item split: If you can send an updated CSV with the bundle split and granular SKU/unit pricing (tax-exclusive), that will speed reconciliation.

I'll propose issuing PR-2026-SL-11 as a provisional purchase ref pending final procurement OK. Laura — can your team issue that provisional PR and tag it as provisional in the ledger? Also, are there any constraints on splitting bundled SKUs into separate billable lines from the vendor side?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Message 3
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@starlite-ware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 16:10:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number and spend ceiling for Starlite order

Thanks Sean. I'm putting Procurement Ops on a short path here. Summary of intended action (procurement side):

- Issue provisional purchase reference: PR-2026-SL-11 (status: provisional) — this will allow AP to accept your first invoice.
- Provisional spend ceiling: set to $75,000 for a 90-day window; will be escalated to finance for permanent cap if utilization looks healthy.
- Line-item correction: we'll accept a vendor-supplied CSV with the bundle split. Procurement Ops will perform a ledger-side remap and add memo notes referencing original vendor ID PR-98765.
- Next steps for vendor: please resubmit starlite_lineitems_v2.csv with separate rows for ST-WR-C (Compute) and ST-WR-S (Support) and include unit price and quantity columns.

I'm attaching a short mapping template (purchase_ref_mapping.csv) for your billing team to return. Once we get the updated CSV I'll post the provisional PR in the ledger and send a confirmation email with the assigned PR and internal account code.

Marissa — can you create the PROC ticket (PROC-4321) and assign to Procurement Ops? Add the provisional PR as a tag.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Message 4
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@starlite-ware.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2026 11:42:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number and spend ceiling for Starlite order

Hi Laura / Sean — thanks for the quick turnaround. We updated the line items and attached starlite_lineitems_v2.csv plus the completed purchase_ref_mapping.csv. Highlights: 
- We will reference PR-2026-SL-11 on our next invoice (invoice date 2026-07-15).
- We split ST-WR-LOUD into ST-WR-C (Compute) and ST-WR-S (Support) with unit prices and quantities in the new CSV.
- We accepted the provisional spend ceiling of $75,000 for 90 days. If procurement requires any additional approval from our finance team, let me know and I'll raise it internally.

Attachments: starlite_lineitems_v2.csv, purchase_ref_mapping.csv

If you can confirm once the provisional PR is posted in your ledger I'll notify our AP team to apply it to the upcoming invoice.

Best,
Alicia Moreno
Procurement Lead
Starlite Ware
